_meta.method: web research; see source_urls per group

batteries.confidence: high for primary cells (Energizer 'Industry Standard Dimensions' = IEC/ANSI max/min); medium for Li-ion (manufacturer-specific, no IEC size standard); low for 14500/26650
batteries.notes: diameter/length = MAX envelope (design clearance to these). diameter_min/length_min = industry-standard minimum from the same drawing. Li-ion values are the named cell's datasheet max; other brands vary +/-0.3 mm. Protected/button-top Li-ion cells are 2-4 mm longer.

AA.notes: Energizer E91 / IEC LR6. Positive pip 5.5 max dia, 1.0 min height. Length incl. pip.

AAA.notes: Energizer EN92 / IEC LR03. Pip 3.8 max dia, 0.8 min height.

C.notes: Energizer E93 / IEC LR14. Pip 7.5 max dia, 1.5 min height.

D.notes: Energizer E95 / IEC LR20. Pip 9.5 max dia, 1.5 min height.

9V.notes: Energizer 522 / IEC 6LR61 (PP3). height includes snap terminals; terminal centres 12.95/12.45 apart (max/min).

CR2032.notes: Energizer ECR2032. Negative face dia 17.7 ref.

CR2025.notes: Nominal per IEC naming (20.0 x 2.5); min values not opened from a drawing - assumed same 19.7 dia as CR2032.

CR2016.notes: Nominal per IEC naming (20.0 x 1.6); min values not opened from a drawing.

CR123A.notes: Energizer 123. Pip 9.6 dia ref, 1.0 min height.

LR44.notes: Energizer A76 / IEC LR44 (same envelope as SR44/357/AG13). Neg cap 3.8 min dia.

14500.notes: UNVERIFIED from a primary drawing. Brand datasheets range 14.0-14.5 dia, 49-50.5 unprotected; protected/USB cells up to ~52-53.

18650.notes: Samsung INR18650-35E spec: dia max 18.50 (older rev 18.55), height max 65.25. Protected cells 67-69.5. Design clearance: 18.6-18.8 bore.

21700.notes: Samsung INR21700-50E spec: dia max 21.25, height max 70.80. Draft 21.0x70.0 was nominal, too tight for a holder.

26650.notes: Panasonic CGR26650A max 26.5 x 65.4 (search snippet, PDF not opened); A123 ANR26650 25.96 sleeved x 65.15(+0.5). Generic cells up to 26.7 dia. Medium/low confidence.

ball_bearings.confidence: high (ISO 15 / DIN 625 boundary dimensions; all drafts match)
ball_bearings.notes: Values for shielded/sealed (ZZ/2RS) variants, which is what hobby suppliers sell. Several MR sizes are narrower when OPEN: MR85 open 5x8x2, MR105 open 5x10x3, MR128 open 8x12x2.5.

688.notes: ZZ width; open 688 is 4 mm wide

linear_bearings.confidence: high for d/D/L; medium for retaining-ring groove values
linear_bearings.notes: d/D/L confirmed in LMK..UU table (flanged variant shares body dims). Outer dia tolerance 0/-0.011 (6,8) to 0/-0.013 (10,12); L +/-0.3. Groove dims (B=groove spacing, W=groove width, D1=groove dia) are the commonly published Misumi/Samick LM-UU values, not opened from a primary catalogue.

fans.confidence: high for 60/70/80/92/120 (Sunon drawings opened); medium for 40 (Sanyo drawing via search snippet) and 140 (Noctua spec text via search; noctua.at blocked); low for 25/30/50 spacing and all small-fan hole diameters
fans.notes: hole_spacing = centre-to-centre along one side. Sunon 120 drawing gives 104.8 +/-0.3 (105 nominal). Sanyo 60 mm uses 4.5 holes vs Sunon 4.3. Thicknesses are common catalogue options, not exhaustive. 5015 radial blower: no reliable primary drawing found (Sunon MF50151VX-1B00U is listed 51.7 x 51.6 x 15) - measure the actual part.

50.notes: spacing commonly cited, hole dia unverified

120.notes: Sunon 104.8 +/-0.3, 8-dia4.3; 105 nominal is fine for printing

140.notes: Noctua NF-A14 (spec text). Many 140 fans also have 105 holes.

5015_blower.notes: UNVERIFIED - no reliable drawing; generic units vary ~51-52 mm envelope with 2 diagonal lugs. Measure.

nema_steppers.confidence: high (Oriental Motor PKP dimension drawings read directly); StepperOnline pages blocked (403)
nema_steppers.notes: Oriental pilot heights are 1.5 for 20/28/35/42 frames; NEMA ICS16 table gives pilot depth max 2.0 (NEMA 11/14/17). Hobby motors (StepperOnline etc.) use 42.3 face and 2.0 pilot on NEMA 17. Design pockets for pilot_h 2.0 + clearance. Pilot tolerance 0/-0.033 (dia22), 0/-0.025 (dia38.1).

NEMA14.notes: 26 = NEMA ICS16 / most hobby NEMA14. CAUTION: Oriental PKP23x 35 mm frame uses 29 +/-0.2 spacing and 1.5 pilot. Face 35.0 (draft 35.2 seen on some hobby motors).

NEMA17.notes: Oriental PKP24x: face 42.0, 31 +/-0.2, 4xM3x4.5 deep, pilot 22 x 1.5, shaft 5 with 4.5 flat. Hobby motors 42.3 face, 2.0 pilot.

NEMA23.notes: Oriental PKP26x: 47.14 +/-0.35, 4x dia4.5 THROUGH, pilot 38.1 x 1.6, shaft 8 (flat 7.5). NEMA ICS16 hole 0.205 in (5.2). Hobby motors commonly 5.0-5.1 holes, 6.35 or 8 shaft. Use 5.2 clearance in prints. d_flat for 6.35 shaft is typical value, unverified.

extrusions.confidence: high for Misumi HFS5-2020 / HFS6-3030 / HFS8-4040 (catalogue drawings read); low for V-slot internal geometry (OpenBuilds site unreachable)
extrusions.notes: slot_depth = outer face to back of T cavity (= lip thickness + cavity depth). Misumi nominal opening is 6.0 (2020) / 8.0 (3030); generic Chinese B-type often measures 6.2 / 8.2 - design printed T-tongues at nominal minus 0.2-0.3. IMPORTANT: Misumi 8-series 4040 has a 10 mm slot (not 8). Many EU/Chinese '4040 slot 8' profiles (e.g. 40-series B-type slot 8) exist - store both.

2020_V_slot.notes: Ratrig: slot width 6, depth 6. Bore 4.2 (M5 tap) widely cited but not seen on a primary drawing. V-groove 90 deg incl.; surface V mouth ~9.2 unverified.

4040_misumi_slot10.notes: Misumi HFS8-4040; drawing shows 7 and 5.5 vertical dims (sum 12.5 interpreted as slot depth), 4-R3 corners. Lip thickness not clearly labelled.

4040_slot8.notes: UNVERIFIED generic EU 40-series slot-8 profile; dims vary by vendor.

linear_motion.confidence: high for T8 nut (drawing read); medium for GT2 pulley (vendor page); low-medium for GT2 belt thickness
linear_motion.notes: T8 nut drawing: flange dia22 x 3.5, body dia10.2 x 10 above flange, 1.5 spigot below flange, overall 15, 4x dia3.5 on PCD 16 (M3). GT2 20T pitch dia = 20*2/pi = 12.73 (computed); tooth tip OD 12.2 (Adafruit).

GT2_belt_6mm.notes: thickness/tooth height from reseller listing (Gates official sheet not opened); some sources give 1.38 total

GT2_20T_pulley_5mm.notes: Adafruit #1251; 2 set screws (M3 typical). Hub dia ~16, lengths 15-17 vary by vendor.
